title: alysicarpus heterophyllus
intro: Alysicarpus heterophyllus, commonly known as the Clustered Summer Cucumber or Clustered Moonseed, is a perennial plant belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is widely used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of various ailments such as fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alysicarpus heterophyllus include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antibacterial properties, making it a valuable medicinal plant in many cultures. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
